sloka: विष्णो कथं करिष्यामि महावीर्यपराक्रमः ।असौ हि बलवद्रक्षो युद्धार्थमभिवर्तते ।। ७.२७.७ ॥
transliteration: viṣṇo kathaṁ kariṣyāmi mahāvīryaparākramaḥ ।asau hi balavadrakṣo yuddhārthamabhivartate ।। 7.27.7 ॥

translations.english: O Vishnu, how shall I act, for this demon of great valor and might, this powerful Rakshasa, is indeed approaching for battle.
